verdicts.reason: The two are almost the same layout and share the same flaws. In both, a white rectangle behind 'EVENT MANAGMENT' cuts off the top of the brown owl. Both owls end in hard flat crops above a band of dead white space at the bottom. A pink star sits on the 'S' of 'PARTIES'. The blue owl floats in the middle instead of anchoring a corner as it does in the original. A is slightly worse: its larger headline runs close to the right edge and dominates the frame, while B's slightly smaller headline leaves more even margins and balances better against the left owl.
